requirements.text: The System shall enforce one language-independent documentation contract that requires an Author field, a brief Summary field, and a brief Description field, and accepts optional Usage, Changelog, and Notes fields.
The System shall accept any brief Summary text without enforcing a sentence count.
When the Usage field is present, the System shall require the Usage text to reference at least one unit discovered in the file.
If a required header field is absent or empty, then the System shall deny the write and name the missing field.
The System shall enforce the same public-unit contract of a Summary plus Parameters, Returns, and Errors sections where each is meaningful for every supported language.
